title: 24 in. 201 cc SELECT PACE 6 Speed CVT High Wheel RWD 3-in-1 Gas Walk Behind Self Propelled Lawn Mower W/ Recoil Start
description:
The YARDMAX 24″ 3-in-1 Rear Wheel Drive (RWD) Self Propelled Lawn Mower features mulching, rear discharge and rear bagging options for disposing of grass clippings. Equipped with a durable easy start 201cc OHV YARDMAX engine with automatic choke system, no priming or choking is required for an efficient and powerful performance. This mower features exclusive and industry leading continuously variable transmission (CVT) offering superior speed variability which allows you to mow at a suitable and comfortable pace, adapting to your walking speed. All wheels are equipped with double ball bearings for an increased traction and maneuverability. The YARDMAX YG4760 will make your yardwork job easy and will provide reliable performance and clean-even cut season after season.
Exclusive and industry-leading CVT (continuously variable transmission) offers superior speed variability to adjust the mower’s pace to match your walking speed by simply selecting the 6-speed shift lever.
Starting made easier with the automatic choke system, no need to prime or choke the engine.
Easily clean the underside of the cutting deck with the deck cleanout port.
Single-lever deck adjustment for quickly setting your mow height.
To quickly set your mowing height with seven options ranging from 1.57” to 3.74”.
Double ball bearing wheels for an easy and smooth rolling and an extended durability.
MAXFlow Deck Technology – features a volute spiral deck design for better airflow and mulching performance.
Heavy-duty, 16-gauge stamped steel deck.
Durable, one-piece seamless steel deck reduces vibration for a smoother owing experience.
Large rear bag capacity. Reduces the frequency of emptying during use.
Space saver, the entire mower can be compactly folded for storage in limited garage spaces.
Choose rear discharge, mulching, or rear bagging. 7.9″ front & 11″ rear wheels provide stability and control.
Adjustable Handle Height: Features a durable 3-position handle for comfortable operation
Fully assembled, Ready for immediate use right out of the box.
